relations.subject: Mahinda Deegalle
relations.evidence: Mahinda Deegalle is a scholar and writer who teaches at Bath Spa University.

relations.subject: Mahinda Deegalle
relations.evidence: In 2000, he held the Numata Professorship in Buddhist Studies at McGill University.

relations.subject: Mahinda Deegalle
relations.role: B.A. Honours degree in Buddhist Studies
relations.evidence: Deegalle attended the University of Peradeniya and obtained a B.A. Honours degree in Buddhist Studies.

relations.subject: Mahinda Deegalle
relations.role: Master of Arts in Theological Studies
relations.evidence: He studied Comparative Religion at Harvard University, where he obtained a Master of Arts in Theological Studies degree.

relations.subject: Mahinda Deegalle
relations.evidence: He obtained a Ph.D. in History of Religions from the University of Chicago.
